title: Wisdom
definition: Wisdom is living before God with reverence, discernment, humility, and obedience according to His truth.
summary: Wisdom is living before God with reverence, discernment, humility, and obedience according to His truth.
christFocus: Jesus is the wisdom of God, and His Word and Spirit teach believers how to walk faithfully in a complicated world.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Wisdom is more than intelligence, age, or life experience. Biblical wisdom begins with the fear of the Lord and learns to view life through God’s truth.

Scripture gives wisdom for speech, relationships, money, temptation, work, suffering, conflict, and decision-making. It forms people who can choose what is faithful rather than what is merely easy.

Christ is the wisdom of God. The cross may look foolish to the world, but it reveals God’s saving wisdom and teaches believers to trust Him above human pride.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Many people are overwhelmed by choices, advice, and pressure. Wisdom gives a path that is steadier than impulse, trend, or emotion.

This doctrine helps those rebuilding life after failure or addiction. Wisdom is not just knowing what went wrong; it is learning to walk a new way with God.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Ask God for wisdom before acting. Search Scripture, seek godly counsel, examine your motives, and choose the path that honors Christ even when it is not the easiest path.
